mission: Make it dramatically easier for an ordinary human with a meaningful vision to accomplish extraordinary things with AI without becoming an AI project manager.
north_star: Maximum verified human value per unit of effort, with compounding intelligence and continuity.

truth_owners.evidence: Execution receipts, CI artifacts, runtime/render/whole-journey evidence

operational_state_rule: The control-plane STATE/BLOCK/MAP/PROOF surfaces form the canonical operational control plane. .naya/memory/STATE.json is a compatibility/history projection and cannot override or compete with live Git identity or control-plane state. Runtime proof freshness is claim-scope based: repository commits that do not modify the source paths used by a deployment/runtime claim do not invalidate that claim; the exact source-scope commit and deployment identity remain recorded.

continuous_smart_flow.flow: NAYA ENTERS → IDENTITY → LIVE REPOSITORY HEAD → CANONICAL SOURCE MAP → CANONICAL STATE RESTORE → CURRENT MISSION → CURRENT PROJECT → ACTIVE EXECUTION BLOCK → PROTECTED BASELINE → AUTHORITY → WORK COMPLETED → PROOF → UNKNOWN/FAILURES → SINGLE NEXT ACTION → EXECUTE → VERIFY → RECORD → UPDATE STATE → UPDATE RECEIPT → GENERATE TORCH → NEXT NAYA ENTERS → SAME TRUTH → CONTINUE
continuous_smart_flow.acceptance: A completely cold Naya can restore the current operational truth and execute the single next action without conversational archaeology or human reconstruction of repository state.

intelligent_hub_pre_execution.lane_rule: Assistant lane is the Cloudflare/live Hub; other Naya lane is GitHub 509. Never merge, promote, overwrite, or treat the two runtimes as one implementation.
intelligent_hub_pre_execution.current_capability_boundary: GitHub repository operations are available; Cloudflare editing/deployment capability is not currently exposed in this tool environment.
intelligent_hub_pre_execution.law: No Naya may build, modify, redesign, restructure, deploy, or declare completion of Intelligent Hub work until the Hub Read-First set has been reviewed and the relevant deeper canonical sources have been inspected.
intelligent_hub_pre_execution.reason: Human and machine context loss are treated as architectural risks. The repository must remind the Naya instead of relying on memory.

protected: MAXIS Living Sun presentation direction as recorded in Issue #69, without coupling presentation to scoring truth
Intelligent Hub Master Design Contract and its one-object/many-projections architecture
Intelligent Hub 6-to-10 execution roadmap and checkpoint sequence

execution_escalation.scope: Every consequential Naya/NayaPOWER/MAXIS execution, debugging cycle, investigation, verification cycle, and recovery attempt.
execution_escalation.rule: After three materially equivalent failures/blockers, stop blind repetition and perform a strategic reassessment. Attempt four must be materially different. More than ten materially equivalent attempts without strategy change is RED ALERT unless an explicit human-authorized exception is documented.
execution_escalation.required_record: ATTEMPT COUNT → OBSERVED RESULT → EVIDENCE → CURRENT HYPOTHESIS → ALTERNATIVE HYPOTHESIS → STRATEGY CHANGE → NEXT TEST

execution_map.current_program: P0 — Public Front Door + Consolidated Human Acceptance
execution_map.definition_of_done: The Superbrain can execute comparable V1/V2 cases with immutable policy lineage, independently verified real outcomes, deterministic responsible-value comparison, adversarial protection, and truthful PROVEN/NOT_PROVEN results, then a fresh Naya can retrieve the result and continue one safe action.

design_direction.core_principle: The assessment is a living intelligence environment; the human choice visibly changes the environment while the question remains the visual priority.
design_direction.presentation_boundary: Presentation consumes MAXESS state; MAXESS engine remains authoritative for questions, answers, progression, scoring, and results.

resolution_rules: Resolve canonical identity before repository search.
Resolve the canonical source map before interpreting overlapping documents.
Historical/superseded names are aliases, never current locators.
Current repository HEAD is authoritative over recorded HEAD claims.
UNKNOWN cannot satisfy VERIFIED or RACE_READY.
A block cannot be VERIFIED without appropriate evidence.
One highest-value next action must be exposed for the current block.
When materially equivalent execution fails three times, stop repeating the same approach and perform a strategic reassessment before another attempt.
After ten materially equivalent attempts without a material strategy change, treat the condition as RED ALERT and require a materially different route or documented human-authorized exception.
For Hub work, resolve and review the Hub Read-First gate before implementation or consequential execution; skipping it is a continuity/architecture failure.
For Hub implementation, follow the canonical 6-to-10 roadmap checkpoints and do not declare completion until exact runtime evidence exists.
Runtime and policy proof freshness is evaluated against the authoritative source paths that produced the claimed artifact, not merely the repository's unrelated documentation/control-plane HEAD.
